aliases: Search for the Lepton Flavour Violating Decay mu+ -> e+ gamma with the Full Dataset of the MEG Experiment

claim.quote: a new upper limit on the branching ratio of this decay of BR( mu+ -> e+ gamma ) < 4.2 x 10^-13 (90% confidence level) is established, which represents the most stringent limit on the existence of this decay to date

name: Search for the Lepton Flavour Violating Decay μ⁺ → e⁺γ with the Full Dataset of the MEG Experiment

significance.quote: a new upper limit on the branching ratio of this decay of BR( mu+ -> e+ gamma ) < 4.2 x 10^-13 (90% confidence level) is established

summary.plain: MEG's final answer, using every bit of data it collected: no sign of a muon turning into an electron and a flash of light, setting the strictest limit yet on how rare that decay could be.
summary.technical: Final MEG result on the full 2009-2013 dataset (7.5x10^14 stopped muons on target): no excess over background, setting BR(mu+ -> e+ gamma) < 4.2x10^-13 at 90% C.L., the most stringent limit at time of publication.

title: Search for the Lepton Flavour Violating Decay mu+ -> e+ gamma with the Full Dataset of the MEG Experiment
why_it_matters: mu+ -> e+ gamma is forbidden in the Standard Model but predicted at an observable rate by many extensions (e.g. supersymmetric or seesaw models); a null result at ever-tighter limits constrains those models.
